leagues.name: UCI WorldTour (men's road cycling)
notes: 18 UCI WorldTeams granted 2026-2028 licences by the UCI Licence Commission (UCI press release, 2026-2028 cycle).
Every team is named after a sponsor; names change with sponsors.
Sponsor placement here is mapped to the schema's front/back/sleeve/shorts/partner values from 'team title/name' and 'jersey'.

claims.text: Human Rights Watch's 2026 world report records that Bahrain's authorities continued jailing opposition leaders and human-rights defenders, used torture and denial of medical care in detention, kept twelve death-row inmates at imminent risk of execution, and ran a kafala system that ties migrant workers to employers and excludes domestic workers from core labour protections.
claims.short: Bahrain: imprisoned opposition, torture in detention, kafala for migrant workers

source.name: Human Rights Watch — World Report 2026, Bahrain chapter

claims.text: Human Rights Watch reports that Kazakhstan continues to restrict freedoms of expression, association and assembly, prosecutes critics on overbroad 'extremism' charges, and has failed to fully investigate the January 2022 protests that left 238 dead and where detainees were tortured; the UN Human Rights Committee raised serious concerns about torture and use of force against civil society.
claims.short: Kazakhstan: restricted freedoms, torture, unpunished January 2022 deaths

source.name: Human Rights Watch — World Report 2026, Kazakhstan chapter

claims.text: Human Rights Watch's 2026 world report records that France's civic space was downgraded to 'obstructed', police repression of protests restricted expression and assembly, the UN Committee Against Torture flagged excessive force against people of African and Arab descent and non-nationals, and the ECtHR condemned France for racial profiling by police.
claims.short: France: restricted civic space, police violence and racial profiling

source.name: Human Rights Watch — World Report 2026, France chapter

claims.text: Human Rights Watch's 'Grounds for Concern' report found that Belgium's counterterrorism response after the Paris and Brussels attacks led to police abuse and discrimination disproportionately targeting Muslims and people of North African or Turkish heritage.
claims.short: Belgium: counterterrorism policing and discrimination concerns

source.name: Human Rights Watch — Grounds for Concern: Belgium's Counterterror Responses to the Paris and Brussels Attacks

proposedRatings.reasoning: XRG is wholly owned by ADNOC, in turn wholly owned by the Government of Abu Dhabi. Same Abu Dhabi state money as Etihad: a 2024 mass trial of 43 activists with life sentences, upheld by the Federal Supreme Court in March 2025. serious.

Samruk-Kazyna is Kazakhstan's sovereign wealth fund and the state is a major sponsor via it. Kazakhstan's record (restricted freedoms, torture, 238 dead in January 2022 and incomplete justice) fits serious.
AlUla is the Saudi Royal Commission for AlUla, a government agency. Carries the Saudi state's record (a record 345 executions in 2024); serious, matching Riyadh Air / Sela.
A Bahraini state agency; the Bahraini state's documented record (imprisoned opposition, torture, kafala) is serious.
Mumtalakat is Bahrain's sovereign wealth fund; same Bahraini state money. serious.
Bahrain national oil company, state-owned. serious by owner.
Bahraini telecoms group with majority state-linked ownership. serious by owner.

Lotto is Belgium's state National Lottery, so it carries the Belgian state. Belgium's documented issues (counterterrorism policing, discrimination) are milder than the Gulf states, so concern rather than serious.

FDJ is the French national lottery; the French state remains its largest shareholder after the 2019 privatisation. France's civic-space/policing record fits concern. (Merged with Groupama in the team name, so the state link is one step removed.)

unsourced: SportQory Sports Support Fund is credited as a main partner by XDS Astana GM Alexandr Vinokurov (Kazinform, 2025-12-28), but its legal ownership and structure were not found.

The 2026 renewal terms of AlUla's sponsorship of Team Jayco AlUla were not found; the original 2023-2025 deal and the 2026 partner page (greenedgecycling.com/2026/2025partners) document the brand on the team but not value or end date.
No publication date shown on the UCI licence-allocation press release; the URL/name say '2026-2028 period'. The UCI spells one team 'TEAM PICNINC POSTNL' (typo for Team Picnic PostNL).
The normalized owners.json entry for 'mumtalakat' has parentId 'mclaren-group'; its actual ultimate parent is the Government of Bahrain, but the shared id was reused as-is here.

NSN Cycling Team is Swiss-registered and Barcelona-based via NSN and Stoneweg; not state-linked. Israel-Premier Tech rebranded to NSN for 2026 after protests over Gaza (Cyclist 2026-07-14 and The Inner Ring 2026-07-10 both note this).
UAE Team Emirates' private management/owner structure
XDS is a private Shenzhen bike maker; its exact ownership was not found beyond press description (The Inner Ring, 2026-07-10).
Bapco Energies/Beyon/National Bank of Bahrain/Al Salam Bank/Alba ownership percentages were not individually verified; grouped under Bahraini state-linked ownership.
